name: Mamori Hoken
description: Mamori Hoken — an independent insurance agency theme laid out like an app: under a formal top header, a night-ink sidebar holds the synced office board (advisers in today, hours, claims line, reply time, closed days and a Book a consultation button) and stays beside the page while it scrolls. The header splits the menu around the centred agency name, with the Book a consultation button at its end. Hanada (#2792C3), the clear indigo-washed blue of traditional Japanese dyeing, is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are hanada fields set in night ink, textured with a faint repeating pencil pattern of umbrellas, houses and raindrops. The hero is text left, art right: the title, lead, buttons and this month's questions on the field, a framed pencil sheet of life events (house, car, shop, school, clinic along one road) on the right, and a cut-out paper umbrella (transparent WebP) that breaks out over the frame and the hero bottom edge; a cut-out house breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a pencil-sketch illustration with a soft hanada wash. LINE Seed JP for display, Public Sans for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b5-1 (sidebar-app, text-left-art-right hero, split nav, pattern-texture, pencil-sketch, hanada #2792C3, LINE Seed JP + Public Sans, business-services). A formal top header with the agency name centred between the menu and the Book a consultation button; the sidebar holds the synced office board. Pattern texture: a repeating pencil pattern of umbrellas, houses and raindrops textures every hanada field and the ink sidebar. Break-frame: the cut-out umbrella breaks out over the framed hero sheet and the hero bottom edge, and the cut-out house over the story band and page heads.

summary.zh-TW: 縹色的獨立保險經紀：側欄顯示辦公室現況、左文右圖主視覺、鉛筆素描的人生地圖、去背紙傘破框而出、鉛筆圖紋底紋，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A hanada blue insurance agency: a sidebar office board, text-left hero with a pencil life map, a cut-out umbrella breaking the frame.
summary.ja: 縹色の独立系保険代理店。事務所のようすを示すサイドバー、左に文字・右に鉛筆画の人生地図、枠を越える和傘、鉛筆模様の地紋。
summary.fr: Un cabinet d’assurance bleu hanada : tableau du bureau en barre latérale, hero texte à gauche et carte au crayon, parapluie détouré.
summary.de: Ein Versicherungsbüro in Hanada-Blau: Bürotafel in der Seitenleiste, Hero mit Bleistiftkarte des Lebens, freigestellter Schirm.
